Definition: to shoe, i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod
BiblicalUsage: In Isaiah we find çâʼan, the word for to shoe, a soldier shod. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâʼan is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
